question_text: A responsible-AI program must continuously evaluate a model for bias across demographic groups both before deployment and as production data drifts over time, integrating alerts when fairness metrics degrade. Which AWS service is purpose-built for this bias and explainability analysis?

options.text: Amazon SageMaker Clarify, with metrics emitted to CloudWatch for alerting on fairness degradation

explanation: SageMaker Clarify measures pre-training and post-training bias and provides explainability, and its metrics can flow to CloudWatch to alert when fairness degrades (bias drift). Macie discovers sensitive data in S3; AWS Config tracks resource configuration compliance; Provisioned Throughput is a capacity mode — none perform demographic bias analysis.
source_topic: SageMaker Clarify for bias and fairness monitoring
